newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: There was strong demand for all grades at the Calcutta tea auction, traders said on Friday.
In all, 2.34 million kg, including 164,129 kg of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.

In CTC grades, demand for Dooars grades was firm. Assam varieties were dearer. There was good export enquiries for Assam fannings. Commonwealth of Independent States countries extended support for brokens, brokers said.
In Darjeeling variety, Japan buyers showed some interest while in Orthodox grades, demand from Middle East countries was firm.
